remarks: Stunning New Construction in Sought-After Greens Farms:Discover the pinnacle of modern living in this exquisitely crafted new construction home, offering 5 spacious ensuite bedrooms and an elegant blend of contemporary design and timeless craftsmanship. Thoughtfully designed with high ceilings, abundant natural light, and impeccable finishes throughout, this home is a true sanctuary of comfort and sophistication.The expansive chef's kitchen, featuring top-of-the-line appliances and a generous island, seamlessly flows into a spacious family room with built-ins and gas fireplace, creating the perfect space for gathering and entertaining. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite is a private retreat, complete with a spa-like bath and custom walk-in closet. The third floor provides additional space for play or relaxation as well as a home office or the option for a 6th bedroom. The lower level hosts another spacious relaxation area, a gym or den and a full guest suite with walk-in closet and full bathroom. The spacious mudroom is conveniently located at the garage entrance, tucked away from the living spaces. Enjoy easy indoor-outdoor living with a private fully fenced-in yard - a perfect backdrop for relaxation and entertaining. Located in this prime neighborhood with easy access to three beaches, top-rated schools, shops, and dining, this home provides both luxury and convenience. A rare opportunity to own a truly exceptional new home.
